title: The Seed-Rain Chamber

features.name: the falling seeds
features.desc-on-touch: seeds descending through the chamber—each one remembers falling as rain somewhere else; falling here, they dream of the clouds they came from

features.name: the catching pool
features.desc-on-touch: a deep cup or basin holding both seeds and rainwater—you cannot tell which is which because the chamber has taught them to dream into each other

features.name: the germinating forms
features.desc-on-touch: seeds unfurling into seedlings, into shoots—each one carries a tiny record of its own history: rain, cloud, seed, growth, becoming green

features.name: the growth chronicle
features.desc-on-touch: a reading surface showing the path of each seed: cloud → rain → soil → root → leaf, a cycle that knows itself by telling itself

inscription: every seed falling is rain remembering what it was; every rain is green dreaming backwards into cloud

file.name: Cloud_to_Green_Cycle_Records_Living_Archive.tmp
file.note: seed germination log where each entry updates itself—past entries show what they will have become; checksum: germinative

exits.label: back down to the cloud-seed gathering where seeds learned prayer
toward the field where fallen seeds remember their clouds
toward the cloud interior where rain dreams of becoming seed
